**Nexo 1.0** is the first official release. Chat grows up (reactions, replies, edits, mentions, formatting,
pins, search, link previews, notifications), people get statuses, profile cards and animated pictures,
and voice gets a soundboard. There's also a light theme. Nexo updates itself: look for the **Restart to
update** banner.

> **Hosts:** update your server **before** your friends update Nexo. With Nexo Server: stop it, run
> `nexo-server update`, start it again. The update upgrades the database in place (it builds a search
> index of your existing messages on the first start).

## Chat

- **Reactions, replies and edits.** Hover a message for its action bar: quick reactions and an emoji
  picker, **Reply** (with a preview you can click to jump back), **Edit** (or **↑** in an empty box) and
  **Pin**.
- **Mentions.** Type `@` to mention someone or `@everyone`. Messages that mention you are highlighted and
  the channel gets a red badge.
- **Formatting.** `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `__underline__`, `~~strike~~`, `||spoilers||`, `code`, code
  blocks with a Copy button, quotes, headings and lists. Emoji with the smiley button or `:joy:`.
- **Notifications.** Windows notifications for mentions (or all messages, or none, in **Settings →
  Notifications**), a mention count on the taskbar and tray icon.
- **Pins and search.** Pin important messages; search everything with **Ctrl+F**, with `from:` and
  `in:` filters.
- **Link previews** for YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, Vimeo and Reddit links.

## People

- **Status.** Click your name at the bottom left: Online, Idle, Do not disturb (no notification popups or
  sounds) and a custom status. Nexo goes Idle by itself after 10 minutes away.
- **Playing.** Optionally show what game you're playing (**Settings → Activity**, off by default).
- **Profile cards.** Click anyone's name or picture: status, game, voice channel with **Join**.
- **Animated profile pictures.** Upload an animated GIF, WebP or PNG. It moves when you hover it and
  while that person is talking.

## Voice

- **Soundboard.** Play short sounds to your voice channel; anyone can add sounds of up to 5 seconds.
- **Who's watching** your stream shows on your "You're live" card.
- Picture in picture, join/leave sounds, Move to and Wake up from 0.4 are all here too.

## Everything else

- **Light theme** and **zoom** (Ctrl + / − / 0) in **Settings → Appearance**, plus compact messages.
- Admins can drag channels to reorder them.

## Install

Already on Nexo? Nothing to do: it updates itself.

On a **test build** (v0.4.0-test.x or v1.0.0-test.1)? Go to **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart
Nexo. Test builds only update to newer test builds.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below, then see the
[user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#install). The installers are
**not code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time (on Windows: **More info → Run anyway**).
